channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Filiação fake de Flávio vira campanha grátis para Renan
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was the target of a fraudulent affiliation with the Mission party, led by Renan Santos, which inadvertently generated free publicity advantageous to the politician. Although based on falsehood, the incident was exploited as a free campaign opportunity for Renan, who gained visibility at no cost. The situation reflects the absurd and often fictional tone of the current Brazilian political landscape.

item.title: Lula diz que só dará agrément a embaixador após eleições e que tenta conversa com Trump
item.description: Lula stated that he will only grant agrément to an ambassador after the 2026 elections and that he is attempting to initiate dialogue with Donald Trump. He also positioned himself as a re-election candidate, reinforcing his strategy to avoid diplomatic appointments before the vote.

item.title: Após reatar com Lula, Alcolumbre encaminha PEC do fim da 6x1 no Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) stated that he has forwarded the government Lula's priority projects to committees, including the Public Security PEC and the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale. This move signals alignment between the Legislative and Executive branches on security and labor reform agendas.

item.title: MP Eleitoral cobra governo Tarcísio e pede câmeras sobre abordagem a Haddad
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office (MPE) has given the government of Tarcísio de Freitas five days to explain the Military Police's approach to the driver of Fernando Haddad, the Workers' Party candidate for governor of São Paulo, which is alleged to constitute an abuse of authority and political intimidation. The investigation aims to determine whether public force was improperly used against Haddad's campaign, potentially constituting an electoral crime.

item.title: Lula cita reciprocidade aos EUA e diz que Brasil "não é pouca coisa”
item.description: President Lula accused the United States of spreading 'falsehoods' against Brazil and announced the invocation of the Reciprocity Law to show that Brazil 'is not insignificant'. He stated that Brazil was hit with a 12.5% additional tariff based on the false claim of using slave labor, arguing the measure is actually an attack on China. Lula also said he is seeking a direct conversation with Donald Trump to ask him not to interfere in Brazilian elections, despite maintaining a good personal relationship with the former U.S. president.

item.title: A estratégia de Lula para ‘vencer’ tarifas dos Estados Unidos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he aims to 'defeat' the United States through 'narrative', arguing that recent tariffs on Brazil — 25% for alleged unfair trade practices and up to 12.5% for failures in combating slave labor — were based on lies. He emphasized that while he lacks U.S.-level military or nuclear power, he will rely on truth and the conscience of the Brazilian people to counter the accusations, claiming the tariffs are a disguised attack on China and overlook Brazil’s efforts against deforestation.

item.title: Lula diz que Lulinha vai ser punido se for culpado: 'Só ele sabe a verdade, eu não sei'
item.description: Lula stated that his eldest son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), will be held accountable if guilt is proven in ongoing investigations, though he expressed trust in his son's innocence. He said he instructed Lulinha's lawyers not to seek dismissal of the cases and wants the investigations to proceed normally, as they did against him. Lula avoided commenting on the actions of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, who oversees some of the probes, citing tensions between branches of government and the risk of making value judgments.

item.title: Davi divulga nota sobre a pauta do Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre released a press note regarding the referral of three priority proposals to Senate committees: ending the 6x1 work schedule, the Public Security PEC, and the creation of the National Policy on Critical and Strategic Minerals. He emphasized that these matters will follow the Senate's regular procedural rules, with due analysis by relevant committees, following an institutional dialogue with President Lula.

item.title: Bispo diz que desgaste com caso Dark Horse decantou, e Flávio Bolsonaro se reaproxima de evangélicos
item.description: Bishop Robson Rodovalho states that the fallout from the revelation that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked for money from Daniel Vorcaro, then owner of Banco Master, has 'settled' and no longer causes significant damage among evangelical voters. He claims the senator is reapproaching this religious segment. The controversy, which emerged in 2024, appears to be losing electoral impact in 2026.

item.title: Alcolumbre manda avançar fim da 6x1, PEC da Segurança e minerais críticos após reuniões com Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre announced the advancement of three priority proposals to relevant committees: PEC 221/2019 ending the 6x1 work schedule, PEC 18/2025 on public security, and PL 2780/2024 establishing a National Policy on Critical and Strategic Minerals. The move followed meetings with President Lula, whom Alcolumbre said had restored dialogue after tensions stemming from the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination.

item.title: Após reatar com Lula, Alcolumbre destravará PECs do fim da escala 6×1 e da segurança pública
item.description: After multiple meetings with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will unblock the processing of two PECs: one to end the 6×1 work scale and another to strengthen public security, both priorities of the executive in Congress. The proposals, which had been stalled due to a rift between Lula and Alcolumbre, will now proceed to the CCJ for review before a plenary vote. Despite the reconciliation, advancement is expected only after the 2026 elections due to a congested legislative schedule.

item.title: Missão entrega ao TSE dados usados na filiação irregular de Flávio para identificar responsável
item.description: The Missão party submitted IP and email data to the TSE regarding the irregular affiliation of Flávio Bolsonaro, including evidence of email opens and link clicks, to identify the responsible party. The party claims it attempted to reverse the registration after detecting a falsified CPF but was blocked due to lack of system permissions. The case was assigned to Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques, with Missão president Renan Santos alleging manipulation and rejecting Flávio’s claim that the emails were mistaken for spam.

item.title: Lula diz confiar em Lulinha, mas afirma que não pedirá encerramento de investigação contra filho
item.description: Lula said he trusts his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and believes in his innocence, but stressed he will not ask for the termination of the investigations against him. He emphasized that the legal process must follow its normal course and that no one will seek to close his son's case. Lula also commented on investigations related to Banco Master and improper deductions from INSS benefits, advocating for accountability and noting the government had already taken action prior to political pressure.

item.title: Lula diz que só vai dar aval a embaixador dos EUA após eleição e falará com Trump sobre processo eleitoral no Brasil
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he will only grant agrément for the U.S. ambassador nominee, Daniel Perez, after Brazil's 2026 elections, citing concerns over potential U.S. electoral interference. He also said he is seeking a direct conversation with Donald Trump to discuss tariffs and Brazil's electoral process, having already initiated formal reciprocity proceedings against the U.S. Lula emphasized he will tell Trump not to meddle in Brazil's internal affairs, especially elections, warning that doing so would result in losses for the U.S.

item.title: Após conversa com Lula, Alcolumbre dá início à análise do fim do 6x1, PEC da Segurança e de minerais críticos
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre initiated the analysis of three government priorities following meetings with President Lula: the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, the Public Security PEC, and the bill on critical and strategic minerals. Although the proposals were forwarded to committees, Alcolumbre stated they will follow the Senate’s regular process without a set voting date, responding to Planalto’s push to advance them before the 2026 elections.

item.title: Crusoé: “Eu não sou contra as pessoas estarem endividadas”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated he is not against people being in debt, during remarks made on Thursday, the 13th. The comment came amid a survey by CNDL and SPC Brasil, released on Friday, the 14th, showing Brazil at its highest level of delinquency in history. Lula suggested that indebtedness is an acceptable social reality given current economic conditions.

item.title: Alcolumbre destrava PEC da Segurança e fim da escala 6x1 após reuniões com Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre forwarded the Public Security PEC and the proposal to end the 6x1 work scale to Senate committees following institutional talks with President Lula. The measures, previously stalled due to a political rift, now proceed through the standard legislative process, with voting expected after the 2026 elections.

item.title: Missão afirma ter localizado endereço de IP de quem filiou Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Missão party claims to have identified the IP address used in the alleged fraudulent affiliation of Flávio Bolsonaro to the party and has submitted the data to the TSE for investigation. The content states the affiliation was illegal and urges the Justice system to identify the responsible party.

item.title: Ministra do TSE que vai julgar uso de 'Bolsonaro de IA' por campanha de Flávio: 'Autenticidade é um direito básico'
item.description: TSE Minister Estela Aranha defended authenticity as a basic voter right during a BBC forum on disinformation, criticizing AI-generated 'more beautiful' versions of candidates. She is one of the judges in a PT lawsuit questioning the use of an AI-generated avatar of Jair Bolsonaro at the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. The trial, overseen by TSE President Kássio Nunes Marques, was postponed and may significantly affect the electoral campaign.

item.title: Retaliar os EUA não faz sentido do ponto de vista econômico, comercial nem eleitoral, diz Graça Lima, ex-negociador do Brasil
item.description: Former ambassador José Alfredo Graça Lima argues that retaliating against the United States makes no economic, commercial, or electoral sense, as it would impose additional costs on Brazilian firms without political gain. He clarifies that invoking the Economic Reciprocity Law does not necessarily mean immediate retaliation against the U.S., but could serve as a negotiation tactic to show governmental action, though he acknowledges it might prove ineffective.

item.title: Lula diz após reciprocidade com EUA por tarifaço que tenta falar com Trump: 'Não se meta nos negócios do Brasil nem na eleição'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said he is trying to establish direct contact with Donald Trump to discuss the U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products and warned that the U.S. should not interfere in Brazil’s affairs or elections. Lula noted that Brazil has formally initiated the Economic Reciprocity Law in response to 25% and 12.5% tariffs, and believes he can counter U.S. accusations by defending Brazil’s position, without seeking confrontation.

item.title: Golden Boy 2026: Cubarsí ultrapassa Yamal após a Copa e lidera ranking; top 10 tem três brasileiros
item.description: Barcelona defender Pau Cubarsí surpassed Lamine Yamal to lead the 2026 Golden Boy rankings after being named the best young player at the World Cup. The top 10 includes three Brazilians: Rayan (7th), Endrick (8th), and Estêvão (10th). The award, organized by Tuttosport in partnership with Transfermarkt, will narrow its list to 20 players in October, when an international jury will select the winner.

item.title: Governo Lula levou mais tempo para liberar empréstimos do governo de SP do que de outros Estados
item.description: The Lula government took an average of 78.2 days to approve loans from the São Paulo state government, nearly three times longer than the national average of 28.3 days, according to Estadão. The São Paulo administration accuses the federal government of politically motivated delays, while the Ministry of Finance denies discrimination and says processing times follow standard procedures. The issue has become a key topic in the São Paulo electoral campaign, with Tarcísio de Freitas alleging political sabotage and Fernando Haddad defending federal impartiality.

item.title: Campanha começa com eleição em aberto e três cenários possíveis
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential campaign is open with three possible scenarios: Lula's re-election, considered slightly more probable due to his ~47% approval rating and upward campaign trend; Flávio Bolsonaro as the main opposition alternative, backed by a loyal base of ~20% despite internal struggles; and a third scenario of polarization breakdown, driven by voter exhaustion and disillusionment, opening space for new alternative leaders.

item.title: Lula diz que vai vencer Estados Unidos na 'narrativa' e que Brasil iniciou reciprocidade para mostrar que país 'não é pouca coisa'
item.description: Lula stated that Brazil will 'defeat the United States in the narrative' and has initiated reciprocity measures to show the country 'is not insignificant'. He accused the U.S. of imposing restrictions based on 'lies', including unfounded claims about slave labor and deforestation, and asserted Brazil has arguments to counter these accusations. The remarks were made during podcast interviews, part of his 2026 re-election campaign strategy to engage younger audiences via digital platforms.

item.title: Rueda declara R$ 75,6 milhões em bens e é o candidato a deputado federal pelo Rio mais rico até agora
item.description: Antonio Rueda, national president of União Brasil, is the wealthiest declared candidate for federal deputy from Rio de Janeiro so far, with R$ 75,6 million in assets, most of which are located outside the state, including properties in Alagoas, Pernambuco, and Brasília. He has never run for office nor lives in Rio de Janeiro, and previously relied on the support of Márcio Canella, a Senate pre-candidate arrested for illegal firearm possession and suspected of money laundering.

item.title: TSE marca para terça reunião para discutir proibição do uso de deepfakes na campanha eleitoral
item.description: The TSE will hold a meeting on Tuesday (18) to discuss a potential broad ban on the use of deepfakes in the 2026 electoral campaigns, including penalties for violations. The debate arises from a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video featuring Jair Bolsonaro’s image used during the PL convention that launched Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid. While the TSE’s current resolution already prohibits synthetic content that alters image or voice to benefit or harm candidates, ministers are still debating the scope of the rule.

item.title: Missão entra com notícia-crime no TSE por filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Missão party filed a crime report with the TSE alleging ideological falsehood in the improper affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the party, stating there was no intent to promote the act and requesting internet providers be summoned to identify those responsible. The party denies any involvement in the fraudulent filing and requests a police investigation.

item.title: A evolução do patrimônio de Flávio Bolsonaro desde sua última eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro declared 8.1 million reais in assets in 2026, a 370% increase since 2018, driven mainly by the purchase of a mansion in Lago Sul paid off in three years. The wealth growth far exceeds his parliamentary salaries, raising questions about the origin of the resources, although he attributes them to 'hard work'.

item.title: Missão reconhece falhas no sistema e pede investigação sobre filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao partido
item.description: The presidential candidate of the Partido Missão, Renan Santos, filed a representation with the TSE claiming internal system flaws allowed the unauthorized affiliation of Flávio Bolsonaro to the party. The TSE denied a hacker attack and confirmed the affiliation was made by a Missão credential holder, ordering the restoration of Bolsonaro’s PL affiliation and suspending the party affiliation system. The party says it was a victim of fraud but denies malicious intent, attributing the incident to operational failures during its developmental phase.

item.title: Após criticar Janja e PT, candidato desiste de cargo no Postalis
item.description: Rafael Cisne Vasconcelos, the candidate approved by Postalis for investment director and supported by the federal government, withdrew from the position after public criticisms of First Lady Janja Lula da Silva and the Workers' Party (PT) on social media were revealed. The selection process was canceled, and Postalis announced a new call will be opened in due time, following regulations and oversight by supervisory bodies.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se reúnem em meio a esforços de reaproximação
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met for the second time this week to deepen dialogue after months of tension. The meeting, held at the Palácio da Alvorada, aims to unlock key government priorities, particularly the PEC to end the 6×1 workweek and the Public Security PEC, both awaiting Alcolumbre’s dispatch to proceed in Congress.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro no Maracanãzinho e Lula em Bangu: candidatos à Presidência fazem atos no mesmo dia no Rio
item.description: On the 22nd, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will launch his presidential and state campaign at Maracanãzinho, while Lula (PT) will kick off his re-election bid at Estádio Moça Bonita in Bangu. The simultaneous events highlight national polarization, with local alliances such as Eduardo Paes (PSD) supporting Lula and Flávio partnering with Douglas Ruas. The latest Quaest poll shows Lula leading with 38% versus Flávio's 30% in the stimulated scenario.

item.title: Imóveis, herança e empresa nas Bahamas: o patrimônio declarado por Silvia Abravanel ao TSE
item.description: Silvia Abravanel, federal deputy candidate for the PSD and daughter of Silvio Santos, declared to the TSE a net worth of 47.5 million reais, including two houses, a rural property, a residential building, an apartment, fixed-income investments, and a stake in a Bahamas-based company. Notably, 9.3 million reais of this amount pertains to pending inheritance processes tied to a legal dispute with São Paulo’s State Treasury over inheritance tax on Silvio Santos’ fortune held in tax havens.

item.title: Crusoé: Efeito Tiririca
item.description: Comedian Francisco Everardo Oliveira, known as clown Tiririca, made history in Brazilian politics in 2010 by winning 1.3 million votes for federal deputy from São Paulo for the Partido República (PR) with the slogan 'it can't get worse than this'. His strong vote count inspired other candidates from various parties to adopt similar strategies, creating what became known as the 'Tiririca Effect' in that year's election.

item.title: Com candidatura registrada, campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro tenta virar página da fraude em filiação e reduz embate com Missão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro secured his presidential candidacy registration after the TSE restored his PL affiliation, resolving the immediate issue of his irregular filiação with the Missão party. His campaign now seeks to downplay the incident, treating it as an ongoing legal matter and avoiding direct confrontation with Renan Santos of Missão, despite mutual accusations. The tone has shifted from broad allegations against 'the system' to a cautious stance, leaving responsibility to be determined by official investigations.

item.title: Governo vê Lei da Reciprocidade como instrumento de negociação com EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government views the Economic Reciprocity Law as a negotiation tool with the United States, not an immediate retaliatory measure. The goal is to pressure Washington into returning to a dialogue based on technical and commercial criteria, after viewing U.S. tariffs as a politically motivated move tied to election mode and broader influence in Latin America. The process includes a Camex report within up to 60 days, diplomatic notification by Itamaraty, and openness to dialogue before any countermeasures are considered.

item.title: Qual a data dos debates entre candidatos a governador nas eleições de 2026?
item.description: Governor candidate debates in the 2026 Brazilian elections began on August 9 on Bandeirantes, featuring Fernando Haddad (PT) and Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) in São Paulo, marked by low ratings and backstage confusion. Additional debates have taken place or are scheduled across states, including Minas Gerais (rescheduled to August 16), with simultaneous debates in all 26 states and the Federal District set for September 29 via Globo and affiliates.

item.title: Lula evita debates e mídia tradicional e privilegia canais digitais mais alinhados ao petista
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has been avoiding traditional media interviews and signaling he will not participate in first-round presidential debates, instead opting for informal digital platforms such as the 'Não Inviabilize' podcast, 'Inteligência Ltda.', 'Meteoro Brasil', and 'Os Três Elementos', where he focuses on personal narratives and sidesteps controversial topics. This shift in communication strategy aims to cultivate a less hostile and more favorable environment for his image as the 2026 election approaches.

item.title: A sapiência mineira (por Ricardo Guedes)
item.description: The text offers a nostalgic reflection on politics in Minas Gerais, invoking historical figures like Tancredo Neves, Benedito Valadares, and Magalhães Pinto as symbols of wisdom and humanity in public governance. It criticizes the current political landscape, represented by Zema and the rise of Cleitinho in polls, lamenting the loss of dialogue and civic values, while hoping for a political rebirth inspired by the legacy of Tiradentes, Guimarães Rosa, and Tancredo.

item.title: Futuro Nacional, partido de ultradireita, quer atrair italianos do Brasil
item.description: The far-right Italian party Futuro Nacional (FN), led by General Roberto Vannacci, unveiled an electoral program offering fiscal incentives to attract productive-age Italians living abroad, explicitly citing Brazil, Venezuela, and Argentina to counter demographic decline. The platform also tightens citizenship rules by extending residency requirements from 10 to 20 years, demanding advanced Italian language proficiency, and rejecting jus soli. Despite being Italy’s fifth most popular party and posing a threat to Giorgia Meloni’s coalition, the program omits any reference to the government’s controversial citizenship reform.

item.title: Os minutos preciosos de Lula para a campanha de aliados
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva received allied candidates at his campaign headquarters in Brasília, where they recorded campaign materials alongside him. According to Radar, some candidates left with approximately five minutes of raw footage with the petista, considered a valuable asset for electoral advertising.

item.title: Após Flávio no Missão, suspeitos tentaram filiar Renan ao PCdoB
item.description: Following the fraudulent affiliation of Flávio Bolsonaro to the Missão party, suspects attempted to use the name of Renan Santos, the Missão presidential candidate, for an unauthorized affiliation with the PCdoB. The attempt was detected via institutional email from Renan’s campaign at 2:30 a.m. on Friday (August 14), but was not completed due to the TSE’s shutdown of the 'Filia' system the previous night, after the Flávio case. President Lula’s name was also similarly misused in attempts to affiliate him with Missão and the Christian Democracy party, all blocked before reaching the TSE.

item.title: Com R$ 242 milhões, Augusto Cury declara maior patrimônio entre candidatos à Presidência
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate for the Avante party, declared R$ 242.28 million in assets to the Electoral Justice, making him the wealthiest candidate in the race. His fortune is anchored by a R$ 121.1 million loan to Filadélfia Nature Participações e Empreendimentos, plus investments in BDRs, Bradesco and Petrobras stocks, and rural and urban properties. Other candidates reported significantly lower net worths, with Romeu Zema second (R$ 178 million) and Lula last (R$ 4.77 million).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende carteira de motorista para jovens a partir dos 16 anos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocated during a live stream that individuals as young as 16 should be allowed to obtain a driver's license, linking the proposal to reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16. He argued that earlier criminal accountability should be accompanied by granting new rights to youth, such as the right to drive. However, the proposal to allow licensing at 16 is not included in his 76-page government plan, which only references supporting the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility.

item.title: Lula recebe Alcolumbre no Alvorada para nova conversa de reaproximação
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) at the Palácio da Alvorada in a third meeting aimed at reconciliation after a three-month rift. The discussions centered on the 2026 presidential election and the 2027 Senate presidency race, with Lula seeking Alcolumbre’s public backing for his re-election bid and offering to support Alcolumbre’s continued leadership of the Senate in return. The talks also covered legislative priorities, including ending the 6x1 work schedule, with government officials describing the relationship as 'unblocked' following the meetings.

item.title: Lula ainda tenta votar 6x1 antes da eleição e tem novo encontro com Alcolumbre
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) at the Palácio da Alvorada, as part of a broader effort to mend ties between the Executive and Legislative branches. The meeting comes amid government efforts to advance a proposal to reduce the workweek to 6 hours per day with one day off (6x1), a contentious issue in Brazil’s labor and political discourse. The outreach aims to strengthen political alliances ahead of the pivotal 2026 elections.

item.title: Dólar toca R$ 5,23 após bolsa perder ‘quase uma Vale’ com fuga de estrangeiros
item.description: The dollar rose to R$ 5,23 as foreign investors accelerated withdrawals from the Brazilian stock market, with a net outflow of R$ 11.93 billion in the first seven trading days of August. Over seven consecutive sessions of decline, listed companies on B3 lost R$ 279 billion in market value—about 90% of Vale’s current valuation. The trend is driven by fiscal concerns, election uncertainty, and JPMorgan’s downgrade of Brazilian stocks from 'overweight' to 'neutral'.

item.title: Augusto Cury declara R$ 242 milhões em bens ao TSE; Júlio Delgado, vice na chapa, diz ter R$ 3,5 milhões
item.description: Augusto Cury, the Avante party's presidential candidate for 2026, declared R$242 million in assets to the TSE, including R$121 million lent to his own company. His running mate, Júlio Delgado, a former federal deputy from Minas Gerais, declared R$3.5 million in assets. Cury advocates for political reform, including a semi-presidential system and ending life tenure for STF justices.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que assessoria recebeu e-mails do Missão sobre filiação, mas achou que eram spam
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed his staff received automated emails from the Mission party regarding his affiliation, which they mistakenly marked as spam due to unfamiliarity with the party, preventing his initial candidacy registration. The Mission party says it attempted to warn his office about a alleged fraud in his affiliation but received no response. The TSE reinstated his affiliation with the PL, and Flávio accused the PT of trying to illegally affiliate him, which he denounced as an insult.
